description: DiligenceOps: submit privacy claims and the privacy policy or other supporting document. The signed report tags each claim collection, sharing or retention and marks it supported, contradicted or never mentioned by the document, quoting the sentences behind each finding, such as a retention period or a sharing practice that differs. POST /api/privacy-evidence-check. Reads only the material in the call: no page fetch, no account access, no merchant contact and no money movement. Paid URL: 0.10 USDC per call on Base via x402 exact, with the shared 10 signed-wallet free calls per rolling 30 days. Bind X-Wever-Wallet-Proof to the exact JSON arguments and the tool route. Returns a report with an Ed25519 signed receipt. The report matches words, figures, dates and named items between the submitted texts; it does not interpret meaning beyond that matching. Contract: /api/diligence-terms-contract. Human page: https://weverlabs.com/diligence-checks/.

claims.description: The claims as one text, which is split into parts at sentences, semicolons, commas and joining words, or as a list of up to 50 parts.

document.description: The privacy policy or supporting document, up to 256 KB.

document_label.description: Optional name for the material, recorded in the report.

format.description: html reduces the markup to readable text first. Defaults to html when the text starts with a tag, otherwise text.

name: wever_privacy-evidence-check
title: Privacy evidence check
